messages.subject: Nested Conditional Panel for UI
parts:
I'm trying to create a page where there are six plots. I want to make the plots dynamic so that the user has the options to chose any number of given plots (by a ticker box using checkboxGroupInput()). On server, if I put a condition then its occupies the space with empty plot. I want to allocate that space to the graphs selected by the tickers. I'm trying to use nested conditional panel as there is already a condition to select single or multiple data set. The following code on the UI with nested conditionalPanel() doesn't work.

conditionalPanel(
                         condition = "input.noofVariable == 'Single' && input.plotGraphsSelection1 ==1"
                         ,plotlyOutput('xyz'
                                       ))
, 
conditionalPanel(
                         condition = "input.noofVariable == 'Single' && input.plotGraphsSelection1 ==2"
                         ,plotlyOutput('abc'
                                       ))
, 
conditionalPanel(
                         condition = "input.noofVariable == 'Single' && input.plotGraphsSelection1 == 3"
                         ,plotlyOutput('def'

                                       ))

This output is manipulation from Server with if() condition. Conditional panel manipulation produces no output at all.
